searchText: We've got an image for `peerdas-devnet-4`: `sigmaprime/lighthouse:sigp-pr-6828-7e397c0` Branch here: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/6828 I've tried running a local devnet with Prysm but the network split on the first Fulu slot - we got a state root mismatch when processing the first Fulu block from Prysm. I've looked at the SSZ of the states but haven't found the root cause of why they don't match. Will investigate further tomorrow. OK, will look at it! That's quite strange because the state and beacon block do not change between electra and fulu. Update from Nimbus — we’re having issues with column sync, unfortunately due to which the BN is crashing, recently our sync strategy was changed and it didn’t include columns as we were making it solely for pectra. Hopefully things should be fixed in the next 2-3 days. If there was an option to have the new sync as optional I would’ve tried to interop with Prysm atleast, but it isn’t. So a couple more days, to get things totally working from our side cc <@531934490826768418> https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LmE791emdXFr7e1ijmmlUtoA04YbGKk3/view?usp=sharing the enclave dump, however logs only go back ~6h in the past :/ Notes from the PeerDAS breakout call today https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ng2IrCe28kTt1BnIsjtMlKHq2MHgaja24LhFXSvqfJQ/edit?usp=sharing - Client teams mostly working on Fulu activation and subnet decoupling. Some teams started local interop testing. - Teams to focus on local interop testing with Kurtosis for the time being. - Pre devnet test scenarios from <@531934490826768418> : https://hackmd.io/@manunalepa/BJzNsCnvyx - Kurtosis sync test tool for testing: https://github.com/ethpandaops/kurtosis-sync-test - Video to be posted later <@415109946682769408> By any chance do you have a screenshot of dora? It helps to see what is wrong chaos started here: larger fork here: and eventually I guess no one is able to agree on a fork and chain dies Kurtosis interop config Here, the slot 25920 is voluntary ignored by `4-geth-prysm` because of the `--data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20` option. (`25920%20 == 0`) This node orphans some blocks, but eventually gets back on track at slot 25937. So I would say nothing wrong with this node on this screenshot. But however `1-geth-prysm` has two missed slots 25934 and 25936, which is not good. Here, the slot 25920 is voluntary

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content:
We've got an image for `peerdas-devnet-4`: `sigmaprime/lighthouse:sigp-pr-6828-7e397c0`

Branch here: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/6828

I've tried running a local devnet with Prysm but the network split on the first Fulu slot - we got a state root mismatch when processing the first Fulu block from Prysm. I've looked at the SSZ of the states but haven't found the root cause of why they don't match. Will investigate further tomorrow.

excerpts.author: manunlp
excerpts.content: That's quite strange because the state and beacon block do not change between electra and fulu.

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content:
Update from Nimbus — we’re having issues with column sync, unfortunately due to which the BN is crashing, recently our sync strategy was changed and it didn’t include columns as we were making it solely for pectra.

Hopefully things should be fixed in the next 2-3 days.

excerpts.author: agnxsh
excerpts.content: If there was an option to have the new sync as optional I would’ve tried to interop with Prysm atleast, but it isn’t. So a couple more days, to get things totally working from our side

Here, the slot 25920 is voluntary ignored by `4-geth-prysm` because of the `--data-columns-ignore-slot-multiple=20` option. (`25920%20 == 0`)
This node orphans some blocks, but eventually gets back on track at slot 25937. So I would say nothing wrong with this node on this screenshot.
